name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a love for restoring vintage Lada automobiles in his youth. He quickly realized his talent for paintwork and attention to detail, honing his skills in a small garage outside Moscow. A chance encounter with a local racing team led to an apprenticeship, and eventually, a full-time position as a paint specialist.

Dimitri approaches his work with methodical precision, believing that a flawless paint job isn't just about aesthetics, but also about aerodynamic efficiency and protecting the chassis. He's known for his innovative use of materials and techniques, constantly experimenting to improve durability and performance. He joined Anderson Racing three years ago, and has since become an indispensable part of the team.

What sets Dimitri apart is his unique blend of technical expertise and artistic flair. He sees each car as a canvas, and takes immense pride in ensuring that every detail is perfect. His keen eye for color and design, combined with his pragmatic approach, makes him a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

physical.skinTone: Light, with a tendency to sunburn
